title: Quiver Demazure algebras I: Residue descent, finite quotients, and PBW bases
summary: We study quiver Demazure algebras through residue covers and root-power quotients. The cover determined by the zero-root subsystem identifies the additive algebra with a finite fixed algebra of Sauter's generalized quiver Hecke construction. Her basis theorem then gives additive PBW in every finite Weyl type, for arbitrary admissible residue data and uniform quivers. A sequence-cover argument gives global multiplicative PBW in simply-laced type.
